page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine instance belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and runs on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 2 dedicated physical cores with 2 vCPUs, providing a 1:1 thread-to-core ratio. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, translating to 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance type includes a bundled graphics processing unit, specifically one NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of dedicated VRAM. Local storage is not included on the instance, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external network-attached block storage. The baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large offers entry-level GPU acceleration by pairing a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with a small CPU and memory footprint. This resource density makes it suitable for workloads that require GPU acceleration but do not demand massive CPU or system memory resources. Appropriate workloads include small-scale machine learning inference, video transcoding, entry-level CUDA development, and lightweight graphics rendering.
